name: events-ui
description: UI reactiva sobre un log de eventos en SQLite para monitorizar repositorios.

scripts.check: corepack pnpm check:contract && corepack pnpm check:versions && corepack pnpm check:puerto && corepack pnpm check:ui && corepack pnpm check:py && corepack pnpm check:test && corepack pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:ui: corepack pnpm --filter desktop check && corepack pnpm --filter events-ui-webapp check && corepack pnpm --filter @events-ui/ui check
scripts.check:py: uv run --directory services/core ruff check . && uv run --directory services/core ruff format --check .
scripts.check:rust: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --lib --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.fix: uv run --directory services/core ruff check --fix . && uv run --directory services/core ruff format . && corepack pnpm --filter desktop exec eslint . --fix && corepack pnpm --filter events-ui-webapp exec eslint . --fix && corepack pnpm --filter @events-ui/ui exec eslint . --fix
